mentions.name: OfflineWebSearch
mentions.description: This app provides private, offline web search with no cloud and no server, using a highly structured meta-database of valuable internet domains, communities, and personal web spaces stored directly on the local device. It ships with a predefined database of common domains and YouTube channels and is currently available only through F-Droid.
mentions.problem: Web search typically relies on cloud services and servers, compromising privacy; this offers private search entirely on-device without any cloud or server.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Offline web search. Private web search. No cloud. No server. Just highly structured meta-database of valuable internet domains, communities, and personal web spaces directly on your local device.

Contains predefined database with common domains, YouTube channels
